composition.elementLabel: What is third party or 3P LLM strategy?

composition.elementLabel: Can we change the model provider?

value.message: You can change the model provider in the Now Assist Admin interface by selecting a Skill Group and choosing a preferred provider from the list of available options. This will update all capabilities associated with that group.
